extracted.intended_audience: UC Berkeley faculty, staff, and campus communicators who need to publicize news/events
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for working with UC Berkeley Media Relations to prepare and distribute press releases, media advisories, and other media outreach for campus news and events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release format
rubrics_metrics.description: A press release is written as a news story, with quotes from the involved parties and with context about the news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are produced in consultation with Media Relations. They are one of the most frequent communication tools used to get news to local, national and international media. Media Relations will work with you to identify newsworthy events and determine the best way to release the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media advisory format
rubrics_metrics.description: A media advisory quickly lists the 'who, what, where and when' of your information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a media advisory when you need to succinctly notify media about the basic facts of an event or announcement. It is presented as a short factual listing rather than a full news-story style release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selecting the appropriate communication tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether a press release, media advisory, press conference, or targeted pitch is the best way to release the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Relations will consult with you to choose the best communication tool (press release, media advisory, press conference, or pitching by phone/e-mail to selected reporters) based on the nature of the news and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newsworthiness assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify whether the event or information is newsworthy before preparing outreach materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Relations helps you identify newsworthy events and provides a 'What's Newsworthy?' resource. Determining newsworthiness influences the choice of release format and how the story is pitched.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of quotes and contextual information
rubrics_metrics.description: Include quotes from involved parties and provide contextual background about the news within the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotes and context help shape the release as a news story and give reporters usable material. Media Relations collaborates to craft these elements appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media relations support and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Relations will provide tips on interacting with the media and tap an extensive list of media contacts to get the word out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include media outreach, pitching, contact lists, media training workshops, crisis & strategic communications support, and access to related resources (Experts Directory, campus broadcast studios). Use the Media Relations staff directory and contact channels to coordinate.
